notes.title: The New Update Is Here – And It’s FREE!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=dlPr0PjL3VM;full][/previewyoutube]

The wait is over – the new content update is now live!

As we teased in our previous post, today we're rolling out a brand new update packed with fresh content – and yes, it’s completely free for all players!

Here’s what’s new:
[list]
[*] 2 new playable levels, designed in continuity with the project’s original vision
[*] 20 new artworks to discover and collect, offering a deeper journey into Cucchi’s creative world
[/list]

This update expands the archive and enriches the experience for both new players and longtime fans.
Thank you for your continued support – we can't wait to hear what you think!

Fantastico Studio *

notes.title: Announcing new levels, difficulty modes & expanded OST!
notes.notes:
Hello folks, 
we have some good news for you!

[list]
[*] [b]New levels[/b]
[/list]
We are working on 3 new levels which will be ready before summer.
We can't tell you too much at the moment but we can show you some previews:

[previewyoutube=0RSyOP4YzJc;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40861217/cb98626e5b75652ff2a7b540dc1c4fe06568800f.png[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]New game modes[/b]
[/list]
In the latest update, following the users' feedback, we have introduced 3 game modes. 
For all those who want to have a relaxing experience, it’s now possible to play without the skulls in our new easy mode. While for all those who love challenges they can try the hard mode where the number of skulls is doubled in each level. Obviously is still possible to play CUCCCHI in its original version by selecting the normal mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40861217/d55a2d4a009ec8fffead494953693bb9aab314d8.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]OST updated[/b]
[/list]
Starting from today the new album from [b]Skinless Lizard[/b], who is the man behind the CUCCCHI’s Original Soundtrack, will be available to buy on Steam, Bandcamp & Spotify. 
His latest work is called “Death Went Smiling” and some of the tracks will be featured in the new levels of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40861217/d2eb6a46a2d2707c1bba6f58154653c4244a4a11.png[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]IGF finalists 2022[/b]
[/list]
CUCCCHI has been nominated on the IGF “Nuovo Award” category. 
We will be in San Francisco for the GDC. Come and visit us at our stand in the IGF Pavilion.

[previewyoutube=ff7NpwAQebM;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Enzo Cucchi Game Over
notes.notes:
On July 30th our new project, Cuccchi, will be released on Steam.
We've decided to give you more info to better understand our project.

Enzo Cucchi is an Italian painter. He was a key member of the Italian Transavanguardia movement. His works are held in numerous museum collections including Tate Gallery, Museum of Modern Art, Centre Georges Pompidou, Louvre, Chicago Art Institute.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40861217/ca06fa4c2e20cf30d982db9b438f1e13374fb917.jpg[/img]

Enzo Cucchi has chosen an original way to make his art available: a "gamified archive", with all the information of interest to collectors, scholars, gallery owners, etc., but expressed in a language and method close to the new generations.

In the game, players will cross 7 areas drawn from the artist's works that take life and motion in three-dimensional spaces populated by the fantastic characters that are typical of Enzo Cucchi's work.

[previewyoutube=gDmH7YhCtMQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Players must explore the areas in search of tokens to collect, avoiding evil entities and other dangers that will try to steal them.

[previewyoutube=cIjjB7Q2vEI;full][/previewyoutube]

At the end of the game players can unlock in a virtual gallery the high-resolution images of the works they have collected.

[previewyoutube=1ubN3P-G5LI;full][/previewyoutube]

We have selected 52 works, from the vast production of Enzo Cucchi, which inspired the design of the 7 playable areas. Each work has been redesigned by Julian Palacios, using a mix of 3d and pixel art.

[previewyoutube=CYYqAfkLuAU;full][/previewyoutube]
